text: CL-48371 rejected. DOS and units look fine, but the claim came back for missing rendering provider information. Checked the submission against the visit record and the rendering provider field was blank. Corrected claim needed before it can be processed. CARC 16: Claim/service lacks information or has submission/billing error(s) which is needed for adjudication.
label_reason: The claim cannot be adjudicated because required rendering provider information is missing, making incomplete claim data the primary cause.

text: Re: Claim BR-72614. Following review of the submitted claim, we are unable to allow payment for the outpatient service provided on the date listed. Our records show that the service required prior authorization, but no approved authorization was on file when the claim was reviewed. The office notes attached to the claim describe the visit and include a statement that the service was medically necessary; however, this does not replace the required authorization. Please submit documentation of an applicable authorization or follow the reconsideration process outlined in your provider agreement. CARC 197: Precertification/authorization/notification absent.
label_reason: The payer explicitly identifies the absence of required prior authorization as the reason for denial, while the medical-necessity statement does not address that requirement.

text: Called Quillfield provider services about Q-39182. Rep says the claim was received and the member was active on the service date, but payment was denied after clinical review. The records submitted do not establish that the requested frequency of treatment was medically necessary under the plan criteria. Rep confirmed that the denial is not due to eligibility or missing authorization. Can send additional clinical notes with a reconsideration request. CARC 50: These are non-covered services because this is not deemed a 'medical necessity' by the payer.
label_reason: The payer's clinical review found that the submitted documentation did not establish medical necessity for the frequency of treatment.

text: CL-90542 denied. Timely filing was mentioned during review, but that is not the actual denial reason. Eligibility response shows coverage terminated before the date of service, and no continuation coverage was recorded for that date. Claim needs to be directed to the responsible coverage arrangement if one exists. CARC 27: Expenses incurred after coverage terminated.
label_reason: The decisive cause is that coverage had terminated before the date of service, while the timely-filing reference is explicitly not the denial reason.

text: Claim BR-18463 cannot be considered for payment because it was received after the filing period permitted by your provider agreement. The date-of-service documentation and submitted billing details were reviewed, and no missing information was identified as the cause of this determination. Our records show that the claim was first received after the applicable filing deadline, and the materials submitted do not establish an exception to that deadline. If you believe the original claim was submitted on time, provide evidence of the initial transmission and its acceptance status. CARC 29: The time limit for filing has expired.
label_reason: The payer states that the original claim was received after the applicable filing deadline and that no exception has been established.

text: Q-67240 kicked back as duplicate. Same service date, same billing provider, same billed amount, and same service details as a claim already processed under an earlier submission. This one is not being paid again. If this was intended to replace the earlier claim, submit the appropriate corrected-claim transaction instead of another original claim. CARC 18: Exact duplicate claim/service.
label_reason: The payer identifies the submission as an exact duplicate of a previously processed claim for the same service.

text: Spoke with Copperleaf about CL-23819 after the office saw an authorization-related message in the portal. Rep clarified that the authorization was approved and covered the date of service, but the claim was submitted with a modifier that does not match the service details on file. The claim line therefore failed the payer's coding edits. Rep advised correcting the modifier and resubmitting the claim. CARC 4: The procedure code is inconsistent with the modifier used or a required modifier is missing.
label_reason: The authorization was confirmed as valid, and the stated cause of the denial is an incorrect or missing modifier.

text: BR-55208 denied. Portal says no coverage found for the member submitted. Checked the internal registration and the subscriber details appear complete, but Bramblecrest could not match the insured to an active policy using the information on the claim. No determination has been made about whether the service itself is covered or medically necessary. Verify the payer and subscriber information before resubmitting. CARC 31: Patient cannot be identified as our insured.
label_reason: The payer cannot identify the submitted patient as its insured, so insured identification and coverage matching are the primary issues.

text: Re: Claim Q-81476. We have completed our review of the submitted claim and determined that payment is not available under the applicable benefit provisions. The service was billed with a code combination that conflicts with the description of the service documented in the submitted records. This determination is based on the inconsistency between the reported service and the coding submitted, rather than on the clinical appropriateness of the service. Please review the applicable coding guidance, correct the claim if warranted, and submit the revised information for adjudication. CARC 11: The diagnosis is inconsistent with the procedure.
label_reason: The payer identifies an inconsistency between the submitted diagnosis and procedure coding as the basis for denial, which is a coding error.
